subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with the application of the Directive Principles of the State Policy?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Article 37**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 37** of the Indian Constitution deals with the **application of Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP).**
 
• It states that the Directive Principles are **fundamental in the governance of the country** and it shall be the duty of the State to apply these principles in making laws.
 
• Although DPSPs are not **enforceable by any court**, they are considered essential for achieving the socio-economic objectives outlined in the Constitution.
 
• The Directive Principles aim to ensure **social justice, economic welfare, and political equality** for all citizens.
 
• Some of the key areas covered under DPSPs include **education, healthcare, environment protection, equitable distribution of resources, and promotion of cottage industries.**
 
• These principles are inspired by the **Irish Constitution** and are included in Part IV of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The DPSPs serve as **guiding principles** for the government to create policies and laws that work toward achieving a welfare state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 36**__

 __
 
• **Article 36** defines the term **"State"** as used in Part IV of the Constitution. It includes the **Government and Parliament of India, the Government and Legislature of the States, and all local or other authorities within Indian territory.**
 
 
 
• **Article 38**__
 __
 
• **Article 38** directs the State to strive to promote the welfare of the people by securing and protecting a **social order based on justice—social, economic, and political.**
 
• It also emphasizes the reduction of **income inequalities and inequalities in status, facilities, and opportunities.**
 
 
 
• **Article 39**__
 
 
• **Article 39** outlines several specific principles, such as ensuring **adequate means of livelihood for all citizens**, equal pay for equal work, protection of children, and equitable distribution of resources.
 
• This article is pivotal in addressing social and economic disparities within the country.
